recognize_zh: 周邊血液中兩顆中型淋巴樣細胞，細胞質豐富且呈淡藍色，核圓、染色質中等凝集，右側那顆可見明顯的單一核仁，細胞邊緣略不規則；這種核仁明顯又有豐富細胞質的組合提示毛細胞白血病變異型，但此圖毛狀突起不明顯。
features: Two medium-sized lymphoid cells, about twice the diameter of a red cell
Moderate N:C ratio with abundant pale-to-medium blue cytoplasm
Round, centrally to slightly eccentrically placed nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin
Distinct single nucleolus, most evident in the right-hand cell
Cytoplasmic borders mildly irregular; well-formed hairy projections not evident
Background of normochromic red cells, some with central pallor artifact, and scattered platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells. The cells have abundant pale blue cytoplasm with mildly irregular margins, round nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin and a distinct single nucleolus, best seen in the right-hand cell. Well-developed hairy cytoplasmic projections are not appreciated in this field. Red cells and platelets show no specific abnormality. Findings are compatible with hairy cell leukemia variant in the appropriate context; confirmation requires flow cytometry (CD11c+, CD103+, CD25-negative) and absence of BRAF V600E.

ddx.vs: Classic hairy cells have bean-shaped nuclei with homogeneous chromatin, no prominent nucleolus and circumferential hairy projections, and are CD25+/BRAF V600E-positive.
Prolymphocytes also have a prominent nucleolus but typically less cytoplasm with smooth borders and very high counts without villous features.
SMZL cells are smaller with clumped chromatin, scant cytoplasm and polar villi, and lack a prominent nucleolus and CD103.
Reactive lymphocytes are part of a polymorphous population with deeply basophilic cytoplasm hugging red cells and are polyclonal.
